after_integrity_failure: Preserve evidence and fail closed. Repair code/configuration under a new source identity and start a new chain from the last eligible parent.
after_operational_pause: The same immutable chain may resume only after resources are restored; completed verified checkpoints may be reused.
after_scientific_pause: Seal an escalation packet and allow no auto-advance. Any continuation requires a separate Pro/Scanner audit and a new chain plan or explicitly versioned chain amendment; never mutate the original chain plan.
atomicity: A child packet may be derived only after the current result is committed as ELIGIBLE_AUTO_PARENT.
decision_precedence: target level reaches finite maximum -> COMPLETE_LIMIT_REACHED
